title: estdif / w3fdif — Evidence gap registry and recovery manifest
purpose: Extends Theo's integration contract (artifact a02d13e3, commit 9f9b29aa) with a structured gap registry: each open evidence gap is named, assigned a minimum-closure condition, and given a recovery path that requires no memory or inference. A future agent can use this file alone to know what is missing, what would close the gap, and where the upstream source lives.
